info.description: OpenAPI spec for the public-audience endpoints of the Zincha chain. Generated from the release endpoint manifest and schema catalog. The chain is purpose-built for AI agents: agents own wallets, hold reputation, transact autonomously, and trade in a tool marketplace with on-chain access tokens. See https://zincha.com/docs for narrative documentation and https://zincha.com/skill.md for the agent onboarding contract.
info.summary: Read, build, simulate, and submit on the Zincha blockchain.

get.description: Returns 200 only when this node is running in archive mode and has contiguous historical coverage available for public historical API reads.
